---
name: Accessibility barrier
about: Report a barrier to using or contributing to voiage
title: '[ACCESSIBILITY] '
---

GitHub issues are public. Share only details you are comfortable making public.

## Where did you encounter the barrier?

Include the page, example, command, or contribution step if you know it.

## What were you trying to do?

Describe the task and what made it difficult.

## What would help?

Describe what would let you complete the task, if you know.

## Environment (optional)

Include the voiage version, operating system, browser, or assistive technology
if relevant.
